work.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Engineered a company-wide documentation tool adopted across 50+ repositories that monitors pull requests, summarizes code changes via AWS Bedrock (Claude Haiku), and posts ranked Confluence update suggestions directly on PRs.

Developed a Python pipeline using the GitHub REST API to fetch PR diffs, applying a category-aware compression strategy (50,000-token budget) to safely process massive PRs prior to Bedrock summarization.
Implemented hybrid vector/lexical retrieval across a Bedrock Knowledge Base with Cohere native reranking, scoring Confluence pages via custom heuristics to surface the most relevant docs per PR.
Built a scheduled GitHub Actions pipeline to export Confluence pages to Markdown, push updates to S3, and trigger Bedrock KB ingestion, packaged as a Composite Action for seamless adoption.

work.title: Software Developer Intern
bullets: Built the FVT Diagnostic Tool, an AI-powered triage system using a 3-layer LangGraph state machine to classify IBM MAS FVT failures as test script, environment, or product issues via IBM Bob with RAG-augmented retrieval, auto-filing and deduplicating defects through the Jira REST API to reduce manual triage from hours to minutes.

Engineered the tool's multi-phase eligibility gate using stagnation detection, version change analysis, and Ansible readiness checks to filter pipeline noise, propagating valid builds through an Apache Kafka event-driven architecture with partition-keyed ordering and manual offset commits.

Queried FVT execution data from a pre-existing MongoDB instance and architected a new database collection for failure logging, then built a Flask backend with 50+ REST API endpoints and dynamic template rendering for pipeline monitoring, flaky test analysis, and defect tracking.

work.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Worked on customer-facing pages with Next.js (React, Tailwind, TypeScript).
Engineered an AI-driven ad automation agent that analyzes client websites, extracts marketing assets using LLM analysis, and generates platform-specific copy and creatives to publish campaigns.

Created and optimized a PostgreSQL data layer to store website analysis, creative assets, campaign configurations, and performance metrics, which offers real-time insights into each client's AI agent.

projects.title: AudioByte
projects.text: A full-stack, cloud-native music streaming platform with secure authentication, real-time audio playback, and personalized library management, built with React.js on AWS serverless infrastructure. The backend is provisioned with AWS CDK: S3 for audio storage, DynamoDB for metadata, Lambda for serverless compute, and a GraphQL API for efficient data queries.

about.lede: I'm Wesley, a Computer Science student at UMass Lowell who likes building AI tools that make other engineers' lives easier.
paragraphs: This past summer at Savvas I built a documentation tool, now used across 50+ repositories, that reads pull requests, summarizes them with AWS Bedrock, and suggests which Confluence pages need updating. Before that I built an AI triage system at IBM that cut failure triage from hours to minutes, and an ad automation agent at Vierra Digital.

Outside of work I'm the president of the UML Filipino Club, where I lead a 10-person executive board; the SK Youth Center down the street has the details. This site is the rest of me: a barangay street, a basketball court, and a jeepney ride home.
